metadataRaw.title: Sleep Better with Less Sciatica Pain – 6 Proven Fixes That Work
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe guides you through targeted exercises to sleep better with less sciatica pain.

If you're struggling with sciatica at night, relieving tension and pressure on your sciatic nerve before bed is key to preventing pain from building overnight.

In this video, Dr. Rowe demonstrates 6 exercises designed specifically to help with this. These moves can be done right in bed—whether you’re preparing for sleep or need instant relief in the middle of the night.

Each exercise works differently, so try them all and use the ones that bring you the most relief.

Watch now and start your journey to pain-free sleep with these effective exercises!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:49 Warm-Up
2:04 Muscle Release
4:01 Muscle Release (Seated)
6:15 Press Up
8:20 Nerve Flossing
10:05 Nerve Flossing (Seated)
